I'm Ramuni Shivaa Kiran, a BBA student in Data Science & AI at Woxsen University (Class of 2028), based in Hyderabad, India. I operate at the intersection of business strategy, emerging technology, and human-centered design.

Currently wearing multiple hats — Automation & Agentic AI Intern at Woxsen's AI Research Centre, AI for Agribusiness Intern at Samruddhi Eco Agrifabrix, Treasurer at Jashn, The Cultural Club, and Hult Coordinator at E-Cell Woxsen. I believe every role is a classroom.

Whether it's drafting operational workflows, mentoring peers as a Teaching Assistant, or writing about entrepreneurship — I bring structure to complexity and energy to collaboration.
